worst_performing_load.root_cause: Maximum motor torque and rotational slip (1728 RPM) in Fold 3 combined with premature inner-validation early stopping (E*=2) caused intermediate Inner Race fault (Recording 172) to be partially confused with Ball Fault.

eliminated_failure_modes.inner_race_vs_outer_race: The severe confounding identified in Phase 10.5 (where 0.021" Inner Race was 100% misclassified as Outer Race) is 100% ELIMINATED in multi-load training. Outer Race precision and recall are 100.00% across all loads.

gradcam_insights.observation: Grad-CAM heatmaps show that correct predictions produce localized attribution peaks aligned with periodic mechanical impact bursts. In the misclassified windows of 172.mat, attributions are more diffuse and focus on low-frequency modulation envelopes resembling ball-spin frequency modulations.
gradcam_insights.epistemic_caveat: Grad-CAM reflects model attribution, not physical causation.
